title: PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty Exit China Open After Wasting Match Points
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty faced early exits from the China Open Super 1000, disappointing Indian fans.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty both lost their respective matches at the China Open Super 1000, with Sindhu notably squandering four match points against Chen Yufei.

title: Sai Praneeth's Historic Bronze: Ending India's 36-Year Worlds Medal Drought
indian_angle: This feature revisits Sai Praneeth's monumental achievement, reminding Indian fans of a significant moment in the nation's badminton history.
summary: A look back at B. Sai Praneeth's bronze medal win at the 2019 World Championships, which ended India's 36-year wait for a men's singles medal at the prestigious event.

title: PV Sindhu Claims Japan Open Crown with Dominant Win Over Yamaguchi
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's victory at the Japan Open marks a significant return to form and a major title for India's badminton superstar.
summary: Indian ace PV Sindhu secured the Japan Open title with a commanding performance against home favourite Akane Yamaguchi, ending her title drought and answering her critics.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact the development and competitive landscape for India's young badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has implemented a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: Delhi World Championships: Engaging Gen Z, Alpha Crucial for Badminton's Future
indian_angle: With India hosting the World Championships, this opinion piece highlights the importance of attracting younger audiences to ensure the sport's growth in the country.
summary: An opinion piece discusses the necessity of engaging younger generations, Gen Z and Gen Alpha, to secure the future viewership and popularity of badminton, especially with the upcoming World Championships in Delhi.

title: Kidambi Srikanth Finishes Runner-Up at US Open
indian_angle: Kidambi Srikanth's strong run to the US Open final demonstrates his continued competitiveness on the international stage for India.
summary: Indian shuttler Kidambi Srikanth reached the final of the US Open but was unable to secure the title, finishing as the runner-up after a hard-fought match.
